notes.content:
Improve the running speed of Dece
Fat Boss is divided into two stages, and in the second stage, the armor of the body will burst
Repairing the axe may have some difficulty hitting the target
Fix the issue of shooting when opening pages (maps, task boards, backpacks, operation prompts)
Initial melee operation prompt, melee position adjustment
Fix the issue where monsters can see characters through the door
Add NavArea to reduce the chance of monsters piercing the mold near the door
Fix the issue of monsters flying after death
Finally, the dismemberment site requires authorization from the monitoring room pass, which is located in the B5 monitoring room
Add task guide
Bullets cannot pass through the door and shoot monsters
Operation tips for primary and secondary weapons
Add R replacement prompt on the operation prompt page

[olist]
[*] Correction of flashlight illumination position for shotgun
[*] Fix the collision between the door opening and the character issue
[*] Fixed the issue where zombies can still harm characters after death
[*] Exploding landmines reduces the range of explosion
[*] Increase the flame effect after landmine explosion
[*] Optimization of melee judgment distance
[/olist]

Fixed the bug where conversations were still possible when teammates were not found
The metal door will no longer automatically close after opening
The scattered flashlight was placed in the first storage room
The picking UI of the axe becomes more prominent
